Implement _score(). Takes a result dict and a list of keyword strings. Search across all string values in the result dict (join all str values into one text block, lowercase). For each keyword: count occurrences in the text. Keyword score = sum of (occurrences * (1/total_keywords)) capped at 1.0. Recency bonus: if result has 'created_at', parse it, calculate days ago. Recency score = max(0, 1.0 - (days_ago / 30)). If no date, recency = 0.5. Final score = (keyword_score * 0.7) + (recency_score * 0.3). Return clamped 0.0-1.0.
